d:
Former Defense Secretary Mark Esper discusses the national security questions surrounding Nvidia and China, the Trump administration’s options in Iran and the widening war in Ukraine. Esper, managing partner at Red Cell Partners, says economic pressure on Tehran needs more time to work and calls for a longer-term strategy if the US returns to military action. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
